operations.name: Rectify a raster drawing plane from known dimensions

actions.name: Identify plane evidence and independent metric controls
actions.purpose: Establish one drawing plane and adequate control geometry before choosing a transformation.
actions.intended_use: Prepare dimensional plane measurements or a declared arrangement reference.
actions.inputs: Original raster/page hash; known coplanar coordinates/lengths; unit/frame; intended plane; independent controls.
actions.outputs: Plane/control manifest and selected scale/projective model for CAD-02-A02.
actions.accuracy: Control uncertainty, fitting error, withheld-check threshold and engineering allowance retain separate sources.
actions.evidence: Original pixel coordinates, dimension/survey records, known lens corrections and page condition.
actions.software: Read image orientation/size; inventory control pairs; detect repeated, collinear or clustered configurations.
actions.agent: Distinguish lens distortion, page perspective/deformation, drawing-to-object scale and freehand proportions.
actions.user_decisions: Supply adequate control geometry or choose the relevant plane when ambiguity affects metric results.
actions.dependencies: OpenCV perspective APIs; CAD-R02 conditions; point01 source/unit intake.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: plane preflight consumes image/control evidence and emits model sufficiency, control roles and check IDs.
procedure: Preserve source pixels/orientation.
Locate controls in original pixels and target-plane units.
Separate fitting and withheld controls; record transformation prerequisites.
actions.validation: One length supports uniform scale only with justified front-parallel/isotropic conditions; projective correction requires sufficient nondegenerate correspondences.
actions.failure_resume: Retain alternatives; block named dependent metric features until their control prerequisites exist.
actions.resources: Local metadata/few-point work first; remote high reasoning for plane ambiguity; manual point selection and uncertainty recorded.

actions.name: Estimate plane mapping and rectified derivative
actions.purpose: Map the selected plane to coordinates while retaining original pixel locations.
actions.intended_use: Supply rectified reference pixels and coordinate mapping for OCR/tracing.
actions.inputs: Plane/control manifest; selected model; output sampling/interpolation; target units/frame.
actions.outputs: Transform, coordinate inverse where defined, ancillary rectified derivative and fit report.
actions.accuracy: Per-control residuals and sampling effects remain separate from dimensional uncertainty and engineering allowance.
actions.evidence: Matrix/settings connect original image, target plane and derivative; preserve control IDs and valid mapping domain.
actions.software: Use getPerspectiveTransform for four suitable point pairs or documented estimator; warpPerspective samples derivative.
actions.agent: Inspect control order, spatial coverage, stretching and unsupported plane assumptions.
actions.user_decisions: Resolve conflicting controlling dimensions or geometry-changing control selection.
actions.dependencies: Selected OpenCV signatures; image/crop pixel-center and coordinate conventions.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: rectification adapter emits matrix/inverse, valid domain, fit diagnostics and sampling receipt.
procedure: Validate point order and coordinate conventions.
Estimate selected transformation.
Create derivative and retain original coordinates/settings.
actions.validation: Check finite/invertible mapping and residual distribution across feature regions; inverse maps coordinates, while source pixels remain preserved separately.
actions.failure_resume: Preserve failed matrix/settings; revise the named controls/model and invalidate affected derived coordinates.
actions.resources: Small matrix fit precedes pixel-scale warping; CPU/RAM follows output resolution; remote review uses source+derivative.

actions.name: Check independent controls and publish measurements
actions.purpose: Determine feature-specific dimensional readiness after rectification.
actions.intended_use: Deliver CAD-02 measurement-set for tracing, sketch and building actions.
actions.inputs: Mapping; withheld checks; source uncertainty and per-feature criteria.
actions.outputs: Measurement-set with original/transformed coordinates, units/frame, method, uncertainty and readiness; derivative is ancillary.
actions.accuracy: Independent length differences use distinct uncertainty and computational threshold; every required feature retains engineering allowance.
actions.evidence: Check IDs excluded from fitting; source values, units and spatial coverage accompany results.
actions.software: Transform withheld endpoints and compare dimensions; verify regional scale and frame signs.
actions.agent: Independent reviewer checks feature/control correspondence and residual page/lens distortion.
actions.user_decisions: Supply extra controls or select a supported lower-detail use when precision evidence cannot be obtained.
actions.dependencies: Actual mapping implementation, independent controls, model-contract fields.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: planar checker consumes mapping/checks/criteria and emits residual rows and named downstream readiness.
procedure: Measure withheld controls.
Compare differences and regional consistency.
Publish measurement-set with ancillary mapping/derivative receipt.
actions.validation: Fitted-control agreement and independent-check agreement remain separate; failures block only affected metric uses.
actions.failure_resume: Retain failed rows; revisit CAD-02-A01/A02 for that plane while retaining independent views.
actions.resources: Few-point checks precede dense sampling; local numerical work and remote/manual review recorded separately.

execution_modes.agent_led: Agent selects plane/control associations and directs transform checks for ambiguous drawings.
execution_modes.hybrid: Software fits and measures; agent evaluates controls and model suitability.
execution_modes.software_first: Checked scan/plane classes use fixed rules; insufficient controls or regional distortion enters review.
execution_modes.deterministic: Explicit plane, nondegenerate controls, settings and withheld criteria produce a checked measurement-set.

alternatives: Justified front-parallel scan with uniform scale.
Projective planar mapping from adequate point correspondences.
Manual point selection followed by numerical fitting/checks.
Lower-detail arrangement and precision dimensional uses retain distinct controls/criteria.

merge.branches: Candidates share image/plane/check IDs and record use, coverage, criteria and resources.
merge.evaluation: VLM reviews full/crop control evidence; software compares independent residuals.
merge.combination: Select one coherent mapping per plane; preserve conflicting dimensions and separate planes.
merge.post_merge: Recompute retained coordinates and independent checks; separate reviewer checks meaning.

operations.software_migration: Automate demonstrated scan/planar-photo classes after control sufficiency, degeneracy, wrong-unit, regional-distortion and withheld-check fixtures.
future_tests: Single length with perspective skew leaves general homography blocked.
Collinear/repeated or incorrectly ordered controls fail before derivative publication.
Fit controls pass but withheld length fails from page deformation.
Image axis signs, target units and coordinate inverse mapping survive; original pixels remain unchanged.

operations.name: Recognize dimension text with OCR

actions.name: Locate annotations and retain crop mappings
actions.purpose: Prepare legible annotation regions with their original drawing context.
actions.intended_use: Read dimension candidates for later feature association.
actions.inputs: Original raster/hash; view regions; orientation; optional plane transform; language hints.
actions.outputs: Text-region crops with full-view references, pixel boxes and crop/deskew/resize mapping.
actions.accuracy: Reading resolution affects legibility; resizing text does not supply dimensional accuracy.
actions.evidence: Full image, crop coordinates, source view and preprocessing settings.
actions.software: Create bounded reading derivatives; preserve original image and valid coordinate mappings.
actions.agent: Identify dimensions, leaders, notes and legends; include adjacent arrow/extension endpoints.
actions.user_decisions: Resolve illegible source or uncertain view identity affecting the required annotation.
actions.dependencies: Documented OCR preparation and image-transform interfaces.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: annotation-region helper emits mapped crops and contextual source locations.
procedure: Locate candidate annotations.
Produce recorded reading derivatives.
Retain full view and leader/extension context.
actions.validation: Crop/rotation coordinates map to original pixels; masks preserve inspectable glyph evidence.
actions.failure_resume: Keep original/failed settings; retry only affected region or use manual transcription.
actions.resources: Local work scales with crop pixels; remote VLM receives full view plus selected crops; manual region selection recorded.

actions.name: Recognize glyphs and parse engineering notation
actions.purpose: Separate character recognition from interpretation of numerical quantities.
actions.intended_use: Produce located text and dimension candidates.
actions.inputs: Mapped crops; traineddata/language/version; OCR settings; notation/unit evidence.
actions.outputs: Raw TSV and parsed candidates retaining literal strings, boxes, hierarchy, confidence and alternatives.
actions.accuracy: OCR confidence is recognizer evidence; nominal value, tolerance, unit and count retain distinct fields.
actions.evidence: Original glyph regions and raw OCR rows; parser corrections retain previous token sequence.
actions.software: Run documented TSV recognition; parse signs, decimal separators, fractions, radius/diameter and plus-minus symbols conservatively.
actions.agent: Compare 0/O, 1/I, punctuation, diameter and tolerance symbols with source pixels.
actions.user_decisions: Resolve controlling unreadable values or conflicting notation conventions.
actions.dependencies: Pinned Tesseract/traineddata; engineering parser is proposed.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: annotation parser consumes raw TSV/source context and emits typed candidates with unsupported/ambiguous flags.
procedure: Recognize and preserve raw TSV.
Parse literal tokens into separate quantity fields.
Retain alternative reads and diagnostics.
actions.validation: Every interpreted field traces to literal source tokens; uncertainty remains explicit.
actions.failure_resume: Retain raw outputs; bounded recognizer/crop retry or source-linked manual reading.
actions.resources: Local OCR follows pixels/languages; remote/manual review targets ambiguous glyphs.

actions.name: Associate text with geometric features
actions.purpose: Connect each annotation to the intended feature and quantity.
actions.intended_use: Supply dimensions for sketch, orthographic or wall/opening work.
actions.inputs: Text candidates; full view; object/dimension/extension/leader candidates or manual anchors; frame.
actions.outputs: Association records with label region, feature IDs, endpoints/axis, quantity kind and alternatives.
actions.accuracy: Diameter/radius, centre/edge distance, angle and count use their own source semantics and criteria.
actions.evidence: Label plus leader/extension endpoints and full-view locator; inferred association retains reason.
actions.software: Test incidence, direction and endpoint consistency; enumerate compatible links instead of nearest-text selection.
actions.agent: VLM selects supported feature associations using source context and candidate geometry.
actions.user_decisions: Resolve conflicting controlling interpretations or dimension-chain meanings.
actions.dependencies: CAD-04 candidates are optional enrichment; manually located anchors permit association before vectorization.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: association helper returns candidate links, source locators and selected/ambiguous states.
procedure: Locate annotation line/leader and endpoints.
Enumerate compatible feature links.
Select supported association or retain alternatives.
actions.validation: Independent reviewer checks meaning; software checks endpoint/axis and quantity consistency.
actions.failure_resume: Keep valid transcription while blocking unresolved association; new geometry evidence changes only affected links.
actions.resources: Local spatial comparisons follow labels/segments; higher reasoning for chains; remote/manual effort recorded separately.

actions.name: Publish reviewed text and association evidence
actions.purpose: Deliver source-verified transcription with named downstream readiness.
actions.intended_use: Provide CAD-03 text output and companion annotation records.
actions.inputs: Raw/parsed candidates; associations; source views; review and feature requirements.
actions.outputs: Reviewed text with source/crop IDs, units/tolerances, associations and unresolved alternatives.
actions.accuracy: Explicit dimensions retain source accuracy; image estimates and OCR confidence remain separate.
actions.evidence: Reviewer identity, actual source regions and candidate correction lineage.
actions.software: Check field completeness, units, duplicate IDs and conflicting repeated values.
actions.agent: Independent reviewer verifies literal text and feature associations against source.
actions.user_decisions: Supply replacement image or controlling value for unreadable required annotations.
actions.dependencies: Point01 brief intake and original text output contract.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: evidence exporter emits reviewed text plus structured companion records.
procedure: Verify controlling glyphs and associations.
Record corrections/alternatives.
Publish text and per-feature readiness.
actions.validation: Each usable controlling dimension has source-linked literal and association checks.
actions.failure_resume: Retain prior text revision; invalidate only changed annotation descendants.
actions.resources: Record validation is small local work; remote review/manual correction tracked per annotation set.

execution_modes.agent_led: Agent transcribes and associates source annotations using software evidence.
execution_modes.hybrid: OCR proposes tokens; agent reviews notation/links; software checks fields.
execution_modes.software_first: Demonstrated annotation classes run fixed parsing; ambiguous symbols/links enter review.
execution_modes.deterministic: Verified text/anchors plus explicit notation rules permit deterministic normalization and export.

alternatives: Manual transcription with independent source check.
Mapped Tesseract crop candidates with raw TSV.
Revision-matched vector dimension records when available.
Arrangement labels and controlling precision dimensions retain distinct required review/coverage.

merge.branches: Recognizer, manual and VLM candidates share source/view/annotation IDs and record purpose/criteria/resources.
merge.evaluation: VLM compares original glyphs and line context; software compares quantities and endpoint associations.
merge.combination: Combine complementary text/feature evidence; preserve conflicting values without averaging or confidence voting.
merge.post_merge: Independently recheck every controlling merged annotation before downstream use.

operations.software_migration: Automate checked notation/association classes after glyph, decimal, tolerance, repeated-count, leader and ambiguous-feature fixtures; evaluate text and semantic association separately.
future_tests: Diameter glyph read as digit or decimal lost blocks dependent dimension until review.
Correct text attached to wrong hole fails association check.
Crop transforms preserve annotation and leader endpoint locations.
Nominal value, tolerance, count and unit remain separate; confidence never becomes dimensional uncertainty.
Unreadable feature leaves independent reviewed annotations usable.

operations.name: Extract raster edges, lines and contours

actions.name: Separate stroke classes and inspect source regions
actions.purpose: Distinguish geometric strokes from drawing annotations before vector extraction.
actions.intended_use: Prepare profile/plan candidates with pixel provenance.
actions.inputs: Original/rectified raster; mapping; text/view masks; intended geometry and drawing convention.
actions.outputs: Candidate masks for object, annotation, extension, centre and hidden strokes.
actions.accuracy: Stroke width/localization uncertainty remain image evidence, separate from repair allowances.
actions.evidence: Original pixels, mask/settings and class evidence from full view/crops.
actions.software: Threshold/detect edges with recorded settings; preserve crossing and overlapping class candidates.
actions.agent: Interpret boundary versus centreline and hidden-line convention; retain uncertain class alternatives.
actions.user_decisions: Resolve convention when line style/source context permits several meanings.
actions.dependencies: OpenCV image primitives; OCR masks are optional evidence.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: stroke preflight emits source-mapped class masks and ambiguous regions.
procedure: Inspect classes in full view.
Create candidate masks.
Preserve uncertain/overlapping strokes.
actions.validation: Overlay masks and confirm required features survive preprocessing.
actions.failure_resume: Keep settings/masks; redo only affected regions and invalidate their vector candidates.
actions.resources: Local work scales with pixels; coarse inspection precedes original-resolution feature work; remote/manual classification tracked.

actions.name: Fit source-supported vector candidates
actions.purpose: Convert selected strokes into explicit line/contour/curve proposals.
actions.intended_use: Supply vector proposals for sketch or wall graph interpretation.
actions.inputs: Masks; pixel mapping; plane measurement receipt; curve classes and per-feature approximation limits.
actions.outputs: Segments/contours and separately typed arc candidates with support pixels and fit residuals.
actions.accuracy: Pixel residual, metric deviation and engineering allowance remain distinct; thresholds cite feature/source requirements.
actions.evidence: Hough support, contour chains, fit settings and pre-fit evidence.
actions.software: Use HoughLinesP/findContours/approxPolyDP; arc fitting is a separately selected documented or proposed method.
actions.agent: Choose stroke centreline/boundary and line/arc hypothesis; interpret gaps using source context.
actions.user_decisions: Decide geometry-changing join or curvature assumption when evidence cannot decide.
actions.dependencies: Pinned OpenCV primitives; arc estimator and class interpretation have separate capability records.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: curve fitter consumes support pixels/class/criteria and emits typed alternatives, support sets and residuals.
procedure: Extract line and contour candidates.
Fit permitted geometry types.
Map to plane coordinates with transform and uncertainty.
actions.validation: Review local residual distribution and overlays; short/noisy arcs can retain multiple centres/radii.
actions.failure_resume: Keep unfit pixels; retry bounded model or manual trace without automatic gap closure.
actions.resources: Local extraction follows pixels/support; curve fitting limited to relevant regions; remote/manual choice recorded.

actions.name: Check geometry and publish vector evidence
actions.purpose: Identify usable vector features while retaining source deviations and ambiguity.
actions.intended_use: Provide vector-drawing for CAD-05/CAD-06/DOM-02 and point03 checks.
actions.inputs: Candidates/support pixels; control measurements; selected roles and feature criteria.
actions.outputs: Vector-drawing with IDs, pixel mapping, topology findings and operation-specific readiness.
actions.accuracy: Endpoint gaps, curve deviation and control dimensions retain separate sourced criteria.
actions.evidence: Source overlays, measured differences and repair/classification reasons.
actions.software: Check duplicates, crossings, endpoints, loop containment and independent controls; serialize supported curves.
actions.agent: Independent semantic review checks holes, feature presence and annotation separation.
actions.user_decisions: Resolve ambiguous loop/hidden-edge meaning or source-changing repair.
actions.dependencies: CAD-08/CAD-09 downstream contract; actual vector writer curve support.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: raster-vector audit outputs typed geometry, source map, change ledger and named check results.
procedure: Measure geometry/control differences.
Review original-source overlays.
Publish selected vector revision and handoff.
actions.validation: Check required holes/openings individually; silhouette agreement accompanies feature checks.
actions.failure_resume: Retain failed vectors; revisit class/fit for affected region and invalidate dependent graph/sketch only.
actions.resources: Local checks follow curve/intersection count; remote semantic review and manual repair recorded separately.

execution_modes.agent_led: Agent selects strokes and geometry types, directs fitting and checks.
execution_modes.hybrid: Software proposes curves; agent resolves classes/repairs.
execution_modes.software_first: Checked line-art classes use fixed processing; uncertain roles/curves/gaps enter review.
execution_modes.deterministic: Explicit masks, mapping, curve classes and thresholds produce checked vector candidates.

alternatives: Manual source-mapped OCS/FreeCAD trace.
OpenCV line/contour extraction with explicit semantic review.
Documented learned segmentation as a separate model/weights/resource branch.
Reduced arrangement outline and precision feature trace retain individual coverage/limits.

Potrace's published binary-bitmap-to-Bezier-contour method supplies another curve-candidate branch; the paper supplies algorithm evidence and the future run identifies its actual executable, terms and settings.

merge.branches: Trace/extraction candidates share source pixels and plane mapping with use/criteria/resource records.
merge.evaluation: VLM compares source overlays and class meaning; software measures controls/residuals/topology.
merge.combination: Select compatible curves per feature; new joins retain lineage and explicit criteria.
merge.post_merge: Recheck merged topology, independent dimensions and feature meaning before handoff.

operations.software_migration: Automate demonstrated stroke/curve classes after crossings, double strokes, hidden lines, short arcs, gaps and resolution fixtures.
future_tests: Double strokes preserve centreline-versus-boundary alternatives.
Annotation crossing never silently creates an object branch/opening.
Short arc retains uncertain centre/radius fits.
Threshold removes required narrow slot and fails source review.
Gap repair exceeding its source criterion blocks that loop.

operations.name: Convert raster floor-plan candidates into a wall and opening graph

actions.name: Declare plan conventions and wall/opening candidates
actions.purpose: Give raster/vector candidates explicit building-feature roles.
actions.intended_use: Prepare a source-linked planar wall/opening arrangement.
actions.inputs: Raster-plan; CAD-02 measurement-set; CAD-04 candidates or manual traces; plan legend/conventions.
actions.outputs: Wall edge/centreline convention, candidate walls/openings and source locations.
actions.accuracy: Plan coordinates retain calibration uncertainty; thickness/width evidence has feature-specific source status.
actions.evidence: Original raster, candidate pixels/vectors, symbols and dimension annotations.
actions.software: Inventory candidate wall traces, junctions, opening spans and labels with persistent IDs.
actions.agent: Interpret wall boundaries, centreline, door/window symbols and curved/nonorthogonal geometry.
actions.user_decisions: Resolve boundary convention or ambiguous symbol that changes element identity.
actions.dependencies: Research floor-plan methods provide proposals; manual OCS/FreeCAD trace is a documented alternative.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: plan candidate ledger accepts traced vectors/measurements and returns wall/opening roles and convention alternatives.
procedure: Choose source-supported wall representation.
Locate wall/junction/opening candidates.
Retain ambiguous roles with source regions.
actions.validation: Semantic review checks each role against full plan/legend; orthogonality is conditional on source constraints.
actions.failure_resume: Retain candidates; block only connections/features whose roles remain ambiguous.
actions.resources: Local indexed vectors first; remote VLM/manual interpretation for symbols; learned segmentation adds separately recorded weights/runtime/compute.

actions.name: Construct dimensioned wall and opening relationships
actions.purpose: Create explicit planar connectivity and host relationships from supported candidates.
actions.intended_use: Supply an interpretable graph for CAD wall solids or semantic building authoring.
actions.inputs: Wall/opening candidates; measurement-set; dimension associations; selected convention and criteria.
actions.outputs: Graph nodes/wall edges/opening-host records encoded with vector-drawing metadata.
actions.accuracy: Endpoint joins, wall thickness, opening span and angle each use their own criteria; source right angles are optional constraints.
actions.evidence: Each relationship cites wall/opening IDs and image/dimension anchors; inferred junctions remain labelled.
actions.software: Build adjacency and containment; attach opening intervals to host wall paths; apply explicit dimensions with recorded residuals.
actions.agent: Resolve T/cross junctions, breaks, duplicate strokes and wall boundary/centreline offsets.
actions.user_decisions: Decide conflicting dimensions, host ambiguity or topology change unsupported by evidence.
actions.dependencies: Proposed graph builder over actual supported line/arc geometry; point03 curve/unit checks.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: graph builder consumes candidates/conventions/criteria and emits nodes, wall paths, opening host/intervals and residuals.
procedure: Assign stable node/wall/opening IDs.
Connect only supported junctions and attach openings.
Apply source dimensions and retain changes/constraints.
actions.validation: Check host existence and interval containment, coincident endpoints within criteria, room boundaries where meaningful and sourced angular relations.
actions.failure_resume: Keep conflicting graph variants; revisit only failed adjacency/dimension and invalidate dependent walls/openings.
actions.resources: Local graph operations follow vertices/edges; intersection cost follows candidates; remote/manual work resolves topology exceptions.

actions.name: Verify plan graph and publish vector handoff
actions.purpose: Confirm graph geometry and relationships match the plan and required dimensions.
actions.intended_use: Deliver vector-drawing encoding the reviewed wall/opening graph to CAD-17/DOM-18.
actions.inputs: Graph; original plan; independent controls; selected convention and required feature coverage.
actions.outputs: Checked vector-drawing plus graph/source metadata, measurements and per-element readiness.
actions.accuracy: Independent lengths/opening offsets use separate uncertainty and comparison thresholds; no assumed global right angles.
actions.evidence: Plan overlays, wall/opening IDs, control rows and reviewer evidence.
actions.software: Measure wall lengths/thicknesses, opening stations/spans; test graph integrity, IDs and selected room connectivity.
actions.agent: Independent reviewer checks real openings, host selection, symbol interpretation and required coverage.
actions.user_decisions: Supply source clarification for blocked host/geometry relationships.
actions.dependencies: Versioned graph serializer and dimensional checks; original CAD-05 output remains vector-drawing.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: plan-graph verifier emits geometric/semantic findings and downstream element readiness.
procedure: Check geometry and relationships numerically.
Compare source overlay and interpreted roles.
Publish vector graph with retained alternatives and dimensions.
actions.validation: Curved/nonorthogonal walls retain actual geometry; unsupported downstream curves are explicit route exceptions.
actions.failure_resume: Preserve failed graph and unaffected elements; update affected source nodes/edges and recheck dependents.
actions.resources: Local graph checks first; full-resolution source regions for critical openings; remote/manual review cost tracked separately.

execution_modes.agent_led: Agent interprets plan symbols/junctions and directs graph construction/checks.
execution_modes.hybrid: Software proposes adjacency/hosts; agent resolves roles and source dimensions.
execution_modes.software_first: Demonstrated plan conventions process ordinary cases; ambiguous junctions/curves/openings enter review.
execution_modes.deterministic: Explicit wall paths, opening hosts, conventions and dimensions produce a checked graph.

alternatives: Manual wall/opening trace with source IDs.
Line-candidate graph construction from CAD-04.
Research segmentation/vectorization model with declared training/domain/runtime evidence.
Arrangement graph preserves essential boundaries; dimensioned building graph requires each wall/opening criterion.

merge.branches: Graph candidates share source/frame and comparable feature IDs, with convention/use/coverage/criteria recorded.
merge.evaluation: VLM compares source symbols and candidate relationships; software checks controls/connectivity/hosts.
merge.combination: Combine compatible wall/opening subgraphs through explicit junction remapping; preserve conflicting topology.
merge.post_merge: Recheck graph integrity, source dimensions, required rooms/openings and independent semantics.

operations.software_migration: Migrate checked plan conventions after T/cross junction, curved wall, ambiguous door, nonorthogonal room, host conflict and missing dimension cases.
future_tests: Nonorthogonal or curved wall keeps sourced geometry; no automatic right-angle snapping.
Opening lies on two candidate hosts: retain alternatives until resolved.
Centreline-to-edge convention changes thickness placement and must be explicit.
Broken dimension stroke does not create a doorway.
Merged subgraphs create duplicate node/host IDs and fail integrity checks.

operations.name: Register orthographic drawing views in a shared coordinate frame

actions.name: Identify views and declare their projection frames
actions.purpose: Establish per-view axes, scale and projection convention before matching features.
actions.intended_use: Prepare multiview evidence for candidate 3D reconstruction.
actions.inputs: Vector-drawing bundle containing at least two identified orthographic views; original source mappings; labels/dimensions and control metadata.
actions.outputs: View inventory with plane axes, viewing direction, scale, datum and convention evidence.
actions.accuracy: Per-view scale/coordinate uncertainty retained; separate drawing dimensions from traced estimates.
actions.evidence: View labels, first-angle/third-angle symbol/layout evidence and source entity IDs.
actions.software: Inventory view regions and declared transforms; reject accidental mixing of detail/section/perspective views.
actions.agent: Determine source-supported front/top/side and projection convention; retain view alternatives where ambiguous.
actions.user_decisions: Resolve missing/contradictory convention or view identity before dependent depth inference.
actions.dependencies: Original CAD-06 vector bundle contract; documented orthographic methods; manual OCS/FreeCAD alignment.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: view manifest accepts vector bundle/metadata and outputs explicit view-to-model projection definitions.
procedure: Identify view regions and labels.
Declare each view axes/direction/scale.
Attach control and convention evidence.
actions.validation: At least two identified views are available; auxiliary/section views have their own projection definition.
actions.failure_resume: Retain valid view evidence; block only registration depending on unresolved view identity.
actions.resources: Local manifest/control checks first; remote high reasoning for labels/conventions; manual view association recorded.

actions.name: Match source features and solve registration candidates
actions.purpose: Relate view features through shared model axes and source dimensions.
actions.intended_use: Provide candidate correspondences without inventing hidden depth.
actions.inputs: View manifest; vector entities; dimension associations; common datum and comparison criteria.
actions.outputs: Per-view transforms and feature-correspondence alternatives with residuals.
actions.accuracy: Coordinate alignment uses sourced tolerances and traced uncertainty; it does not replace explicit dimension values.
actions.evidence: Each correspondence cites entities from every contributing view and dimension/section support.
actions.software: Project common-axis coordinates, compare compatible vertices/edges and solve declared scale/offset transforms; retain multiple matches.
actions.agent: VLM uses complete labelled views to interpret repeated/symmetric features and hidden/visible line roles.
actions.user_decisions: Resolve ambiguous matching that changes geometry when other evidence cannot choose.
actions.dependencies: Proposed line/vertex matcher plus numeric transform checks; research methods are evidence for algorithms, not an exercised project adapter.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: correspondence solver emits candidate links, transform receipts and contradictions from view manifests/vectors.
procedure: Identify shared axes and candidate feature pairs.
Estimate permitted view transforms.
Compare dimensions and preserve alternate correspondences.
actions.validation: Independent controls and shared-axis residuals check registration; equal projections can retain several 3D interpretations.
actions.failure_resume: Keep candidates and contradictions; revisit view definition or correspondence only and invalidate downstream geometry.
actions.resources: Local candidate matching scales with features/repetition; prune by source class before comparison; remote/manual interpretation cost separate.

actions.name: Verify registration and publish reconstruction brief
actions.purpose: Give 3D reconstruction explicit view constraints and unresolved alternatives.
actions.intended_use: Deliver model-brief with registered views for CAD-07.
actions.inputs: View transforms/correspondences; independent controls; source dimensional evidence and intended part features.
actions.outputs: Model-brief containing projection frames, correspondences, known dimensions, inferred/ambiguous fields and readiness.
actions.accuracy: Per-axis/view checks retain source uncertainties and thresholds; no depth precision assigned from appearance alone.
actions.evidence: Control checks and source-labelled correspondence graph with producing/reviewing identities.
actions.software: Compare projected control coordinates across views and validate transform chains and feature IDs.
actions.agent: Independent reviewer checks convention, visible/hidden/section roles and source meaning.
actions.user_decisions: Supply depth/section/feature evidence needed by blocked 3D claims.
actions.dependencies: Point01 brief evidence contract; CAD-07 explicit vector/measurement/brief inputs.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: registered-view brief exporter preserves frames, alternate matches and exact downstream prerequisites.
procedure: Validate cross-view controls and identities.
Review feature correspondence semantics.
Publish registered-view brief and unresolved dependencies.
actions.validation: Reconstruction readiness names features and source constraints; successful registration alone cannot choose among equal-projection shapes.
actions.failure_resume: Retain prior brief revision; changed view scale invalidates its correspondences and affected 3D descendants.
actions.resources: Local projection checks are bounded by feature count; remote review uses full views plus located regions; manual missing-source work recorded.

execution_modes.agent_led: Agent interprets view conventions and competing correspondences, directing projection checks.
execution_modes.hybrid: Software matches axis-compatible features; agent reviews symmetry, hidden edges and sections.
execution_modes.software_first: Checked view conventions/feature classes run registration; repeated features or conflicting scales enter review.
execution_modes.deterministic: Explicit view frames, feature correspondences and controls produce a checked registration brief.

alternatives: Manual alignment with exact view/source controls.
Geometric axis/vertex matching for explicit conventions.
Registered learned orthographic-reconstruction candidate method within its demonstrated object class.
Arrangement view constraints and precision part correspondence retain different required features/criteria.

merge.branches: Candidates share source view revisions; record convention, frame, feature coverage and target use.
merge.evaluation: VLM examines full view set and source annotations; software compares independent coordinates/dimensions.
merge.combination: Select coherent view/convention mapping; compatible correspondence evidence joins by source feature ID.
merge.post_merge: Recheck all per-view transforms, controls and source associations before CAD-07.

operations.software_migration: Automate checked view-layout classes after convention reversal, mixed scale, repeated features, auxiliary views and contradictory dimension fixtures.
future_tests: First-angle/third-angle swap reverses interpretation and fails sourced convention checks.
Mixed view scale passes appearance but fails control dimensions.
Repeated symmetric features retain multiple correspondences.
Single view fails the multiple-identified-view prerequisite.
Auxiliary/section view cannot silently inherit front/top/side axes.

operations.name: Reconstruct a candidate 3D wireframe and surface from orthographic views

actions.name: Enumerate source-constrained 3D feature candidates

common_protocol.scope: Point03 common_protocol supplies revision/request identity, separate producer/reviewer, native and remote uncertain-completion reconciliation, changed-source invalidation, per-feature criteria and migration gates. All detailed raster procedures and helpers remain proposals.
common_protocol.image_coordinates: Preserve original bytes and image/page hash. Each crop/rotation/deskew/resize/projective warp/lens remap has explicit source and target frames, order/direction, pixel-center/grid convention, valid domain/mask, sampling/interpolation and version. Store forward/inverse coordinate mappings where defined; mappings locate source coordinates and cannot reconstruct discarded/resampled pixels. Transform OCR box corners as polygons; curved lens mappings retain adequate boundary sampling and actual remap representation.
common_protocol.metric_evidence: Separate physical page rectification from drawing-to-object scale. Explicit source dimensions, independent measurements and image-derived estimates keep distinct status. At each measured feature record nominal/unit/source, engineering allowance, measurement uncertainty and computation/fit threshold; kernel/solver and export thresholds have their own scope. Transform localization/control uncertainty with a documented method into feature coordinates; no fixed pixel threshold silently becomes a global engineering tolerance.
common_protocol.branches: Every candidate branch binds source/view/brief revisions, intended use, source subset, feature coverage/detail, units/frame, per-feature criteria and local/remote/manual observations. Keep branches isolated until evidence-based selection. A VLM means vision-language model: it receives full views plus located crops, endpoint/line evidence and actual numerical reports. It selects supported interpretations within current intent; source conflicts/new design choices go to the specific user decision.
common_protocol.validation: Separate semantic reviewer execution from producing/merging interpretation; record actual/requested identities and shared models, pixels, OCR, source and kernel dependencies. Numerical results identify actual artifact and query/reader. Calibration checks use held-out controls where available and record independent evidence limits; model agreement or fit residual is not a substitute for a required check.
common_protocol.resources: Use metadata, source controls, bounded crops and required-feature checks before full-image or learned processing. CPU/RAM estimates name pixels, labels, curves, candidates or model faces; local GPU use belongs to the actual selected backend. Remote inference calls/tokens/latency/cost and manual tracing/interpretation are separate. Qualitative estimates are proposals; measured cost requires run, hardware, settings and input-size evidence.
common_protocol.failure_resume: Apply point03 native and remote protocols.
